# GTmetrix

GTmetrix is a performance testing and monitoring tool that analyzes website speed, provides detailed performance reports, and helps optimize web applications for better user experience.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/gtmetrix/.

## Actions

- **Get API Account Status** (read-only): Retrieve the current API account state and remaining credits.
- **Get Browsers** (read-only): Retrieve the list of available browsers for GTmetrix performance tests.
- **Get Location Details** (read-only): Retrieve location details from GTmetrix.
- **Get Locations** (read-only): Retrieve the list of available GTmetrix test locations.
- **Get Page Reports** (read-only): Retrieve the report list associated with a monitored page in GTmetrix.
- **Get Pages** (read-only): Retrieve the page list from your GTmetrix account.
- **Get Report** (read-only): Retrieve a GTmetrix test report by its identifier.
- **Get Test Details** (read-only): Retrieve test details for a specific GTMetrix test.
- **Get Tests** (read-only): Retrieve the test list from your GTmetrix account with pagination and filtering support.
- **Start Test**: Start a new GTmetrix test for a specified URL.
- **Delete Page**: Delete a specific page in GTmetrix.
- **Delete Report**: Delete a GTmetrix report.
- **Get Page Details** (read-only): Retrieve page details from the user's GTmetrix account.
- **Get Simulated Device** (read-only): Retrieve simulated device details.
- **Get Simulated Devices** (read-only): Retrieve the list of simulated devices available in GTmetrix.
- **Retest Report**: Initiate a retest of a completed GTmetrix report with same parameters.
